usage_instructions: Use for Facebook browser automation — searching Marketplace listings, managing Messenger conversations, and reading Group posts. Commands follow `facebook <group> <action>` pattern. Requires browser session auth via `facebook auth login`. Most list commands support --table/-t, --filter/-f, --limit/-l, and --properties/-p.
